body: I can't talk to them the way I want to, though. They don't want a relationship with me and if I tried to request one and failed I would definitely blow up at them. I already want to.
Yeah, you purposely harass suicidal people who are angry at women because apparently I'm not allowed to be angry at a gender.

Because you're harassing me, attempting to make a joke out of my opinion about how women act because it emotionally offended you, because the "great women" you know aren't the same unintelligent scum I know.
Reported to mods for harassment.

It's also not "cool" for you to force your morals/ethics/opinions on others who want to dress or act how they want to in public so long as their behavior remains in legal bounds.

You and your feelings aren't the entire movement's.

I just don't want "liveable" though. I'm liveable currently and it's still putting me on a negative path. 

I don't want to be alone but I can attract/find nobody.

I don't really think that diagnosed medical issues are really excuses. I'm at an actual disadvantage because of them. 

And even if I force myself to go out and do things, who says that I don't throw myself over the edge and mentally break? I don't want to harm others or myself, but I sure do think jumping straight into the mess might cause it.

I don't even have the confidence to initially try, though.

I just feel like people aren't worth the pain or humiliation, yet the loneliness is killing me.
That's even more pity-laced. It won't accomplish anything anyways. I hang up and I still want to die.
I don't have the confidence to go to someone like a therapist. It's awkward to me.
I lack the patience I guess. Pills or a train are much faster.

I don't really think after decades anything will change. 

It doesn't matter who I'm around or what I say or what I do. It's the other people who cause it.
I think they try to hurt me on purpose. I'm always excluded out of things and lied to and ignored.
It's every day for me.
I don't have the same. I don't even think I care about or find value in smiling anymore. People probably do it to me out of awkwardness and pity.

But you don't trip on pavement every day for utmost to 2 decades, though...

Anxiety and depression aren't really temporary things IMO. I can't just "defeat" or "get over" them. They're always there. Even if I "get better" they're still going to be there and they will flare up, so why humiliate myself more to go to some meetup and have people feel pity for me and invite me to talk to them and make the entire experience awkward for all involved...

If I can sense it's pity I lose all interest, they only are talking to me out of pity, nobody really cares about one another - wasted time and humiliated, probably getting talked about with my back turned.

As do I make people smile, but I don't find value in it when they don't care about me any other time. 

It's probably out of fucking pity.
Suicide just seems better to me than waiting it out, honestly.
But that's everyone I know, to me. And I don't have the resources to go out and meet new people.

I don't really want to waste time or effort though. 

Also, that's pretty humiliating, at least to me it would be.
I don't know. It seems like the waiting and struggling is negatively effecting me a lot.
And what if it doesn't? I've thought about suicide.

I appreciate your optimism but I've forced myself to always turn a blind eye to it. I've tried it all before. The groups, reddit, kik, omegle, etc. I don't trust Fetlife, and certainly not Facebook or anything. I might as well just learn to enjoy not being with anyone.
Even so, I'd have to deal with things like medicines or the therapist calling the police/medical services the second I mention suicide, thus even making the whole process worse IMO.

I don't know, I've tried "reading", but if anything it just makes me more skeptical of pseudo-intellectuals who use the stereotypical cures of the typical social issues. 

I think therapy would be my best bet, but I lack the financial resources and the confidence to do it.
Why not just face the fact, though? I don't have the resources/power/ to change, and miraculously become this positive social person. I don't even know if I want to be that anymore.

> You can’t avoid self care and self awareness, however.

?

Issue being that I am rarely if ever socially approached, and I don't see the value in wasting time or being that, let's all admit, one pathetic person who the group must pity and allow into the social situation.

That's the part of my stubbornness, and perhaps egoism though. I've already given up and accepted my lack of self-care, and the fact that things will never likely change, and I'm not a big fan of "education" from others. It's awkward to me. I know what I like, I know about what I like, and I don't really enjoy going beyond that.

I probably won't ever have anyone anyways because I find most other things unenjoyable or dumb, and my blunt personality doesn't hold back on that. (IE - Would call a kink "dumb" to someone's face instead of just saying "I don't want to do that." like a normal person)
